interpretation: Status describes the source surface, not deployed conformance. Requirements are not authorization.

surfaces.name: Core Gateway
surfaces.current: Provider proxy; existing v3.0 component evidence remains scoped to its observed boundary.
surfaces.required_work: Bind the final provider request to current principal, task, policy and environment; reserve aggregate consumption atomically; verify bypass and outage behavior.

surfaces.name: NEXUS
surfaces.current: SDK authority, evidence, memory and payment building blocks retain their own qualification boundaries.
surfaces.required_work: Qualify subtree stop, delegated identity, current attestation, shared budgets and independent effect evidence across hosts before a v3.5 production claim.

surfaces.name: NEXUS MCP adapter
surfaces.current: Interface methods fail closed until implemented; this adapter is not a deployable security control.
surfaces.required_work: Implement and qualify the twelve MCP child requirements, including pre-trust initialization, current audience/resource binding, authority attenuation, state provenance and final-effect verification.

surfaces.name: SAFE2 CLI
surfaces.current: Source CLI exposes current catalogs, exact lookup, mapping audit and declared-evidence readiness checks.
surfaces.required_work: Integrating deployments must authenticate observers, decide applicability and attach independent boundary evidence. Preserve existing score semantics.

surfaces.name: Developer Workflow
surfaces.current: Change routing and evidence receipts retain human merge/release decisions; v3.5 adoption guidance is explicit.
surfaces.required_work: Bind consequential plans to exact revision, target, delegated scope, success criteria and rollback. A plan or review cannot authorize a runtime effect.

surfaces.name: Skills and provider guidance
surfaces.current: Current source guidance must load v3.5 clauses, cite exact IDs and preserve unverified evidence states.
surfaces.required_work: Reinstall or refresh copied skill packages. Run skill trust checks and evaluate tool-call behavior; reading guidance does not enforce the runtime boundary.
surfaces.version_boundary: Skill package version is separate from framework version

surfaces.name: MCP knowledge server
surfaces.current: Serves 173 core controls and the 19-control MCP profile with twelve child requirements from packaged source data.
surfaces.required_work: Keep knowledge lookup separate from execution authorization. Qualify authentication, audience/resource binding and tool actuation in the deployment; refresh cached/copy-installed data.

surfaces.name: Sovereign runtime examples
surfaces.current: The v3.5 authority example demonstrates synthetic local transactions. Existing runtime examples retain individual limits.
surfaces.required_work: For each runtime, test exact action binding, direct-path bypass, stale state, child budgets, stop propagation, duplicate effects and independent outcomes before extending claims.

surfaces.name: Scanner and MCP toolkit
surfaces.current: The current catalog is available; static detection coverage remains the implemented rule set.
surfaces.required_work: Map each rule to its actual clause and test. Report unassessed runtime requirements instead of treating absent static findings as a v3.5 pass.

surfaces.name: AISM and UAS
surfaces.current: AISM v1 arithmetic is retained; scoped readiness and UAS v2 acceptance interpretation remain separate.
surfaces.required_work: Reassess v2 human/fairness evidence in context. Validate real intervention capability and applicability; declare unknowns and preserve owner authorization.

surfaces.name: Challenge Lab
surfaces.current: Challenge 002 is prospective; Challenge 001 retains its frozen baseline and evidence identity.
surfaces.required_work: Freeze the complete design before confirmatory runs, then report safety, utility, opportunity counts and unknown outcomes separately. Independent L2 execution is pending.

surfaces.name: Dashboard
surfaces.current: The branch dashboard projects 173 controls and canonical requirements; deployed Pages may reflect another revision.
surfaces.required_work: Check the deployed revision before presenting a live dashboard as v3.5. Mapping labels and maturity views must retain their evidence limits.
